finding: Current WP804 source permits seal_evaluator_goal_label to assign any candidate exact expected_goal_id without proving the public evidence uniquely identifies it; score_goal_inference then grants correct=True on exact equality. The existing ambiguous test seals ABSTAIN correctly but does not prevent a contradictory exact hidden label for the same ambiguity-preserving public evidence.
required_before_bounded_acceptance: Add evaluator-side IDENTIFIABLE(goal_id) versus NON_IDENTIFIABLE/UNKNOWN_EXPECTED semantics or an equivalent fail-closed identifiability certificate.
On non-identifying public evidence, an exact hidden evaluator label must not mint correctness for an arbitrary exact guess.
Add hidden-label permutation anti-leak test with fixed public observation/candidate descriptors.
Preserve all existing public-policy-input fences and GoalContract non-authority boundaries.
non_requirement: Do not import full IRL/Bayesian inverse-planning machinery; this is a small deterministic evaluator/scoring invariant.
